yourNature_desc: You are the green on the old stone wall that finds a window wherever a door won't give. You run on less Wood than you use, so you keep your strength close. Because you need to be sure of lasting, you would rather hold back than risk a push that empties you. Over time you pay in reach, since you rarely find out how far you could go on a full supply.

self_card.face: The vine kept low against the wall
self_card.presence: You spend your Wood in small, careful amounts because you need it to last. You would rather get by on very little than let yourself ask for more.

_trace.yourNature_desc: Wood used faster than it comes in, so the reader rations it for safety and pays in untested reach
_trace.presence: the low supply as thrift, its cost the more never asked for
